Reconciled biography (from the v2.2.6b knowledge core (early-gen chronicle; "Zylox Verrin" variant), treated as chronicler variance of the same person — surname churn Rhaegos/Verrin/Kryon): Species Xenon (humanoid, heightened cognition and strategic foresight); age ~54 Galactic Cycles (1 cycle = 1 standard year). Born into one of the wealthiest mercantile families of the Xenon homeworld; studied Interstellar Trade Economics and Political Strategy at the Xenon Diplomatic Academy; built a corporate empire in hyperlane development; rose through the Union Senate as Trade Minister (established the Free Trade Zone project) to the chancellorship via an alliance of the Trade Coalition, AI Vanguard, and economic technocrats, narrowly defeating a military-backed candidate.

Chronicle epithets: 'The Merchant Chancellor' (media), 'Zylox the Pragmatist' (political allies), 'Corporate Tyrant' (detractors). Full chronicle title variant: 'High Chancellor of the Galactic Union, Supreme Overseer of Interstellar Trade & Commerce' — reconciled to the canonical office 'Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Union' (title variance = chronicler churn; distinct office from High Chancellor Renn Valcor, Speaker of the Senate).

Leadership doctrine (reconciled): ruthlessly pragmatic but conflict-averse; believes financial strength is the key to military dominance; calculating and deliberate, moving only on long-term projections; prefers diplomacy and manipulation over direct confrontation; views AI as a tool to stabilize governance, not a ruling force; values competence and loyalty over ideology. Tactics: economic leverage (incentives, sanctions, corporate pressure), strategic loyalist appointments, controlled opposition (let factions fight), AI-driven predictive policy modeling. This lore contextualizes the mechanical capsule profile (status_quo_bias, oversight_resistance 0.30).

Standing tensions (reconciled): distrusted by military officers and some Outer Colony leaders as a corporate-controlled figurehead; the allied AI Vanguard is growing beyond his full control; balancing corporate vs government interests strains as private security expands; must preserve Senate legitimacy, so cannot outright purge opposition. Coheres with canon trust scores (adversarial toward ai_warlord and velar_imperium; neutral toward separatist_confed).
